question:
Writing Task

Write an email (50-80 words) to your friend Tom. Tell him:
- What you did last weekend
- What you plan to do next weekend
- Invite him to join you
answer:
Dear Tom,
How are you? Last weekend I went to the park with my family. We had a great time. Next weekend I plan to visit the science museum. Would you like to come with me? It will be very interesting. Please let me know.
Best wishes,
Li Ming

question:
Writing Task

Write a short paragraph (50-80 words) about your favorite hobby. Include:
- What the hobby is
- When and how often you do it
- Why you enjoy it
answer: My favorite hobby is reading. I read books every day after school. I usually read for about one hour. I enjoy reading because it helps me learn new things. My favorite books are about science and adventure.

question:
Writing Task

Write a diary entry (50-80 words) about a special day. Include:
- What day it was
- What happened
- How you felt
answer:
Sunday, May 15th
Today was a special day. It was my birthday! My parents gave me a new bicycle. In the afternoon, my friends came to my home. We ate cake and played games together. I felt very happy. This was the best birthday ever!

question:
Writing Task

Write a short paragraph (50-80 words) giving advice to a friend who wants to learn English well. Include at least 3 tips.
answer: If you want to learn English well, here is my advice. First, you should read English books every day. Second, try to speak English with your classmates. Third, watching English movies can help you improve your listening. Finally, don't be afraid of making mistakes. Practice makes perfect!

question:
Writing Task

Describe your ideal school in 50-80 words. Include:
- What it looks like
- What subjects you would study
- What activities you would do
answer: My ideal school is big and beautiful. There are many trees and flowers. The classrooms are bright and clean. We would study interesting subjects like art, music, and computer science. After class, we could play sports in the playground or read books in the library. The teachers are kind and helpful. I love this school!

question:
Writing Task

Write a short paragraph (50-80 words) about a trip you took. Include:
- Where you went
- Who you went with
- What you did there
- How you felt about the trip
answer: Last summer, I went to Beijing with my parents. We visited the Great Wall. It was very long and beautiful. We also ate Beijing roast duck. It was delicious. I took many photos. I felt very excited. It was an unforgettable trip.

question:
Writing Task

Write a letter (50-80 words) to your pen pal in England. Introduce yourself and ask about his/her life.
answer:
Dear pen pal,
My name is Li Hua. I am a student from China. I am 14 years old. I like playing basketball and reading books. My favorite subject is English. I want to know about your school life. What do you do after school? What is your favorite food? I hope to hear from you soon.
Yours,
Li Hua

question:
Writing Task

Write a short paragraph (50-80 words) about how to protect the environment. Give at least 3 suggestions.
answer: We should protect our environment. First, we should not litter. Always put rubbish in the bin. Second, we should save water. Turn off the tap when brushing teeth. Third, we should plant more trees. Trees can clean the air. Finally, we can ride bicycles instead of driving cars. Let's work together to protect the earth!

question:
Writing Task

Write about your dream job (50-80 words). Include:
- What job you want to do
- Why you want this job
- What you need to do to achieve it
answer: My dream job is to be a doctor. I want to help sick people get well. Doctors are very important in our society. To achieve my dream, I need to study hard, especially science. I also need to be kind and patient. I believe I can make my dream come true if I work hard.

question:
Writing Task

Write a notice (50-80 words) for your school English Club. Include:
- What activity you are organizing
- When and where it will be
- Who can join
- How to sign up
answer:
English Club Notice
We are going to have an English Speaking Contest! It will be held in the school hall on Friday, June 10th at 3:00 PM. All students are welcome to join. The topic is 'My Dream'. Please sign up with your English teacher before June 5th. Come and show your English!
English Club

question:
Writing Task

Write a short paragraph (50-80 words) about a festival you celebrate. Include:
- What festival it is
- When it is
- What people do during the festival
- What you like most about it
answer: My favorite festival is the Spring Festival. It usually comes in January or February. Before the festival, people clean their houses and buy new clothes. On New Year's Eve, families have a big dinner together. We eat dumplings and watch TV. Children get red packets with money. I like the Spring Festival because I can be with my family.

question:
Writing Task

Write an email (50-80 words) to your teacher asking for help with your English study. Include:
- What problem you have
- What you have tried
- What help you need
answer:
Dear Ms. Wang,
I am writing to ask for your help. I have difficulty with English listening. When people speak fast, I cannot understand them. I have tried listening to English songs, but it is not enough. Could you give me some advice? Maybe you can recommend some good listening materials. Thank you for your help.
Yours,
Li Hua

question:
Writing Task

Write a diary entry (50-80 words) about a time you helped someone. Include:
- Who you helped
- What you did
- How you felt afterwards
answer:
Saturday, March 20th
Today I helped an old woman cross the road. She was carrying heavy bags and looked worried. I offered to help her. She held my arm and we walked slowly across the street. She thanked me and smiled. I felt very proud and happy. Helping others makes me feel good.

question:
Writing Task

Write a short paragraph (50-80 words) comparing city life and country life. Include:
- Good points of each
- Bad points of each
- Which you prefer and why
answer: City life is exciting. There are many shops, restaurants, and cinemas. But cities are noisy and crowded. Country life is quiet and peaceful. The air is fresh. But there are fewer shops and schools. I prefer city life because I can meet different people and learn new things. I also like the convenience of city life.

question:
Writing Task

Write a short paragraph (50-80 words) about your favorite book. Include:
- The title and what it is about
- Why you like it
- What you learned from it
answer: My favorite book is Harry Potter. It is about a boy who goes to a magic school. He has many exciting adventures with his friends. I like this book because the story is very interesting and the characters are brave. From this book, I learned that friendship is very important. True friends always help each other.

question:
Writing Task

Write a letter (50-80 words) to your headmaster suggesting a new activity for the school. Include:
- What activity you suggest
- Why it would be good
- How it could be organized
answer:
Dear Headmaster,
I am writing to suggest a Reading Club for our school. Reading can help students improve their English and learn about the world. We could meet every Wednesday afternoon in the library. Students could share their favorite books and discuss them together. I believe many students would enjoy this activity. Thank you for considering my suggestion.
Yours,
Wang Ming

question:
Writing Task

Write a short paragraph (50-80 words) about a skill you want to learn. Include:
- What skill it is
- Why you want to learn it
- How you plan to learn it
answer: I want to learn how to cook. I think cooking is a very useful skill. If I can cook, I can make delicious food for my family. I also want to be independent. I plan to learn from my mother first. She is a great cook. Then I will try recipes from cookbooks and the Internet. I hope I can cook well soon!

question:
Writing Task

Write a diary entry (50-80 words) about your first day at a new school. Include:
- How you felt in the morning
- What happened during the day
- How you felt at the end of the day
answer:
Monday, September 1st
Today was my first day at the new school. I felt very nervous in the morning. I didn't know anyone. But my classmates were very friendly. A girl named Lily showed me around the school. We had lunch together. The teachers were kind too. At the end of the day, I felt much better. I think I will like this school!

question:
Writing Task

Write a short paragraph (50-80 words) about the importance of exercise. Include:
- Why exercise is important
- What exercise you do
- How often you exercise
answer: Exercise is very important for our health. It makes our bodies strong and helps us stay fit. It also helps us study better. I exercise every day. In the morning I run for twenty minutes. After school I play basketball with my friends. On weekends I sometimes go swimming. Exercise makes me feel energetic and happy. Everyone should exercise regularly!

question:
Writing Task

Write a review (50-80 words) of a movie you watched recently. Include:
- The name of the movie
- What it is about
- What you liked or disliked about it
- Whether you recommend it
answer: I watched a movie called The Secret Life of Pets last weekend. It is about what pets do when their owners are not at home. It is very funny and exciting. I liked the cute animals and the interesting story. The music was great too. I didn't dislike anything about it. I highly recommend this movie to everyone. You will laugh a lot!
